task: OQ18 Task A-triple-prime - name the 618 B/series fit-phase residue
the_question: Is the residue one allocation group, several with a stable composition, or a composition that varies with the fixture?

design.primary_fixture: tier 2 (live = 0, every mask identical, no per-series tensor at all)
design.why_tier_2_is_primary: it carries the residue with the tensor structurally absent, so nothing has to be chunked and 17.69 MB is not sitting on top of the subject

what_the_smoke_point_already_read.instrument_defect_found_and_fixed: FitResult.loglik and scores.loglik are one array under two names; the first inventory double-counted them by 18 B/series

predictions.statement: THE NAMED BLOCK IS READ, NOT FITTED, AND IT MATCHES ITS HAND-DERIVATION. The recorded allocations at fit.py:200-211 sum to 193 * M + 16 - 16 = 368 B/series at M = 2 and 1158 at M = 6, and signal.py:509 adds a further 32 at both, independent of n_time.
predictions.refuted_if: the recorded sum differs from the hand-derivation by more than 5 B/series at any arm
predictions.confidence: high - it was read at one fixture already and the arithmetic is a schema, not a model

predictions.statement: THE RESIDUE IS ONE GROUP, NOT AN ACCUMULATION. The resident set across the whole series loop rises under 1 MB at every point of every arm, as it did for the tensor.
predictions.refuted_if: the loop's own maximum exceeds its start by more than 1 MB at any point
predictions.confidence: medium-high - A-prime measured 0.16-0.79 MB at tier 2, but never at M = 6, where there are three times as many per-candidate temporaries

predictions.statement: THE LEVER, AND THE DISCRIMINATOR. If the ~218 B/series of unexplained cost is M-independent, the M = 6 residue is about 1390 B/series; if it scales with the candidate count, about 1790.
predictions.refuted_if: the M = 6 residue falls outside 1250 to 1950
predictions.confidence: this is the measurement, and I hold no prior between the two - which is why both numbers are written down

predictions.statement: THE DOUBTED HORN. The named allocations will NOT close the gap: even at M = 6 the measured residue exceeds the read inventory by at least 150 B/series, so a second unnamed source remains and the answer is a composition rather than one name.
predictions.refuted_if: the measured residue at any arm sits within 100 B/series of the read inventory
predictions.confidence: medium, and it is the horn I expect to hold - which is the opposite posture from C2, where I doubted the horn the repair needed. If D4 holds, the permitted outcome is 'several with a stable composition' and a repair's claim is a sum.

predictions.statement: n_time INDEPENDENCE CONFIRMED. The N = 240 arm's residue lands within 2 sigma of the N = 60 arm's, in the 450 to 700 B/series band.
predictions.refuted_if: the N = 240 residue scales with n_time, which would mean 2472 B/series
predictions.confidence: high - A-prime measured 618.3 and 514.3 at the two lengths, 1.3 sigma apart

predictions.statement: THE PAGE FLOOR IS A CANDIDATE FOR PART OF THE GAP AND IS TESTABLE HERE. Twelve arrays each rounded up to a 4096-byte page boundary costs at most 12 * 4096 bytes per TILE, which is 21 B/series at B = 2304 and 5 B/series at B = 9216 - so it cannot explain 218 and its signature is a gap that SHRINKS with B.
predictions.refuted_if: the unexplained gap per series is constant in B rather than shrinking, which would exclude page rounding as any part of it
predictions.confidence: high on the arithmetic, and it is here so the cheapest explanation is excluded by measurement rather than by argument

permitted_outcomes.one_allocation_named: proceed to elimination, or characterise its removal as A-double-prime did
permitted_outcomes.several_with_stable_composition: a repair is possible and its claim is a sum; the composition is what gets recorded
permitted_outcomes.composition_varies_with_fixture: report and stop - the answer is architectural, and criterion 7's failure is a design fact rather than a missing term
